content: pkgdown BS5: logo goes in man/figures/logo.png (or logo.svg). usethis::use_logo() automates placement + .Rbuildignore. build_favicons() generates pkgdown/favicon/ from the logo. favicon set auto-included by init_site(). bslib theming via template: bslib: bg/fg/primary + base_font/heading_font/code_font (Google Fonts supported). navbar: bg: primary/light/dark, type: light/dark. Social preview: template: opengraph: image: src/alt + twitter: creator/site/card (summary_large_image or summary). No explicit YAML logo: key needed — pkgdown auto-detects man/figures/logo.png.
